result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but one restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of food photography, which is the main visual defect. A couple of minor styling inconsistencies were also noted.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant/food image, making the card look unfinished and inconsistent with the pizza card below it.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/loading pipeline and provide a branded fallback illustration or blurred food placeholder so failed images never render as a raw broken-image icon.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the image-less card is a light gray circle that blends into the gray placeholder background, while the same control on the pizza card is a dark translucent circle; the treatment is inconsistent and low-contrast in the first case.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent heart-button style (e.g., dark translucent scrim with white icon) that maintains contrast regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background, or use a darker field fill.
